Repo: /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa, branch feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component.

Scope-reduction task on Step 4 (ZimmProductCardMedia molecule) of the SFCC-236 build, directed by Marcel: **no confirmed Figma design requires a badge overlaid on the product image — remove the badge/Tag slot entirely from this component.**

Context: this component's `tag` slot was built against the `Tag` frame that exists structurally inside Figma's "Image Group" component set (node 40002742:46322, 78×48 top-left overlay), but Marcel has confirmed there is no actual design requirement backing it — it was a speculative build against a frame's mere existence, not a confirmed spec. Remove it.

## Files to modify (only these 3 — do not touch anything else)
```
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/index.tsx
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/index.stories.tsx
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/index.test.tsx
```
(4 files — the 4 that make up this component; do not touch `theme/components/index.ts`, the recipe key/registration itself is unaffected by removing one part.)

## Required removals

**`index.tsx`:**
1. Remove the `badge?: React.ReactNode` prop from `ZimmProductCardMediaProps` and its JSDoc block.
2. Remove `badge` from the destructured props in the component signature.
3. Remove the entire `{badge != null && (...)}` render block (the `<chakra.div __css={styles.tag} data-card-slot="tag">{badge}</chakra.div>` JSX).
4. Update the top-of-file `data-card-slot` contract comment block — remove the `"tag"` line entirely from that documented list.
5. Update the component's own top JSDoc if it mentions the badge/tag slot anywhere in its prose — remove that mention, don't leave a dangling reference.

**`zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts`:**
1. Remove the `'tag'` entry from the `parts` array.
2. Remove the entire `tag: {...}` block from `baseStyle`'s returned object.
3. Remove the `TAG_MIN_WIDTH` constant and its `audit-allow` comment block (the one citing Figma node 40002742:46323's "Tag" overlay sample width) — this constant has no other use.
4. Update the file's top doc comment (the one listing all the recipe's parts) to remove the `tag` line.

**`index.stories.tsx`:**
1. Remove the entire `WithBadge` story export and its JSDoc comment.
2. Check the top of the file for any now-unused import this removal causes (e.g. if `Box` was only imported for the badge demo pill — check whether `Box` is still used elsewhere in the file, likely yes for the decorator, so probably nothing to remove there, but verify rather than assume).

**`index.test.tsx`:**
1. Remove any test(s) that assert on `badge`/`data-card-slot="tag"` presence or absence (there should be at least one "badge absent when no badge prop" and one "badge present when badge prop supplied" — remove both, or however many exist covering this feature).
2. Remove any reference to `badge` in test fixture/props objects used elsewhere in the file (e.g. if a shared "full props" test fixture includes a `badge` key for some other test's setup, remove just that key, don't break the other test's actual assertion).
3. If the structural recipe test (added in this step's earlier rework round, the one importing the real unmocked recipe module to assert arrows/indicator mutual exclusivity) references `tag` in any way, update it — it shouldn't, since that test was about `carousel`/`indicatorWrapper`, but verify.

## After all removals, verify:
```
npx tsc --noEmit
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts
npx vitest run overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts
npx eslint overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia
node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs
npm run test
```
All must be clean. The test count for this component's own file will DROP (fewer tests, since badge coverage is removed) — report the exact before/after count for this file and for the full suite, don't just confirm "green." `recipeParts.test.ts`'s check for this specific recipe should still pass since `parts` will still exactly match the (now-smaller) set of `styles.X` reads in `index.tsx`.

Also grep the whole repo for any other reference to this component's `badge` prop or `data-card-slot="tag"` that might exist outside these 4 files (there shouldn't be any — no organism consumes this component yet — but confirm rather than assume).

Do NOT stage or commit. Report exactly what was removed from each file (before/after for the meaningful chunks, not necessarily every line), confirm the 4-file scope was respected, and confirm all verification commands pass.
